desc:
⛏️ Spin To Upgrade! ⛏️
Mine ores, upgrade your pickaxe and climb to the rarest gems!

💎 MINE & COLLECT: Break ores, find rare gems and fill your collection.
⬆️ TIER UP: Upgrade your pickaxe to unlock new zones full of better ores.
🗺️ EXPLORE ZONES: Every zone shows which pickaxe you need. How far can you go?
👷 MINERS: Your miners keep earning coins, even while you're offline!
🎡 BOOST WHEEL: Server-wide events spin up to 3x boosts for everyone.
🎁 PLAYTIME GIFTS: Stay online to unlock 8 free gifts, including gems from your best area.

⭐ PREMIUM BENEFITS ⭐
👑 Roblox Premium members get 2x Playtime Gifts: every free gift is doubled!

🔔 Like ⭐ and Favorite ❤️ the game so you don't miss new updates!

Use code 'RELEASE' for free 15 gems and boosts!
